title: Man with Alzheimer's found alive after 11 days in Brazilian Amazon
summary: A 74-year-old man with Alzheimer's disease was found alive after 11 days lost in Brazil's Amazon rainforest, where he ate wild fruit and slept on beds of leaves, rescuers and local media reports said.
